linkedin.text:
You're paying $80/month across ChatGPT Plus, Notion AI, and superhuman email. 💸

Then you hit the problem: your chat tool can't read your inbox, your research assistant can't schedule follow-ups, and your document editor doesn't know what your agents discovered yesterday.

Odysseus fixes this. 🛠️

It's a self-hosted AI workspace that bundles:
✅ Chat + agents with tools, MCP, memory, and shell access
✅ Deep research with multi-step web reading and report generation
✅ Email inbox with IMAP/SMTP, triage, summaries, and reply drafts
✅ Documents, notes, tasks, and calendar with CalDAV sync

You Docker compose up, open localhost:7000, and your entire AI productivity stack runs on your hardware with local or API models. No monthly bills, no data leaving your machine. ⭐

The repo has hardware-aware model recommendations, built-in serving, and a full setup guide for native installs, GPU configs, and HTTPS.

Search "Odysseus AI workspace" on GitHub and check the quick start. 🚀

What's the first workflow you'd move off SaaS and into a local workspace?
